definitions.ml_ds: Rule bucket ml_ds of mart_junior: vacancies (Telegram: posts) of the collection window; graded_junior and graded_senior are of the vacancies whose grade the title rule found (grade_known).
definitions.ml_ds_skill: Vacancies of the bucket naming the skill (rule dictionary), of the bucket; ml_ds_junior_skill of those graded intern or junior.
definitions.salary: mart_extracted_salaries, level grade: stated = vacancies with a RUB monthly amount of the grade's vacancies; from_median and to_median are medians of the posted bounds, rows = vacancies with that bound.
definitions.salary_ml_cell: mart_extracted_salaries, level cell: ML role x junior grade, vacancies stating a RUB monthly amount.
definitions.telegram_year: Single-vacancy IT posts after the weekly cross-post dedup, by year of the week's Monday, extracted fields; ml_posts: role data_scientist, ml_engineer or mlops; junior_posts: grade intern or junior; junior_of_graded: of the posts with a grade; ml_junior_of_graded: the same within the ML roles.
definitions.telegram_ml_skill: ML posts of the year naming the skill (extracted skills), of the year's ML posts.
definitions.telegram_work_format: Single-vacancy IT posts with an extracted grade and work format, by year of the week's Monday; junior: grade intern or junior, other: the other grades; share of the group's posts with a format; telegram_ml_work_format: the same within the ML roles.
definitions.telegram_recent: Telegram single-vacancy IT posts of the weeks whose Monday falls in 2025-2026, extracted fields; groups it_all, it_junior (grade intern or junior), ml_all (ML roles), ml_junior; telegram_recent_skill: posts of the group naming the skill, over the tracked skills and the top 20 skills of the two junior groups; telegram_recent_salary: posts of the grade stating a RUB monthly amount, medians of the posted bounds when 9 or more posts state the bound.
definitions.window: Collection window of the cross-sectional marts per source (mart_skills period_from, period_to).
definitions.telegram_panel: The same over the channels with IT posts in every year 2022-2026.
